playwright.description: Browser automation: navigate, click, fill forms, screenshots, E2E checks. Use for anything requiring a real browser.

context7.description: Up-to-date library/framework documentation and code examples. Use when coding against an API you're not 100% sure about.

github.description: GitHub: repos, issues, pull requests (read + write). Use for anything on github.com.

websearch.description: Web search via self-hosted SearXNG (aggregated engines, private). Also reads page content from result URLs. Use to find current information online.

websearch-fallback.description: Fallback web search (DuckDuckGo, keyless) for when spark.local is unreachable. Enable only then.
